up: Retrieve exactly 200 rows. Return exactly these columns: canonical_smiles, substrate_record_id, metabolite_record_id, substrate_compound_key, metabolite_compound_key, met_conversion, pathway_key. Start from the metabolism table. Perform an INNER JOIN on metabolism.substrate_record_id = compound_records.record_id (alias as cr_substrate). Perform an INNER JOIN on cr_substrate.molregno = compound_structures.molregno to fetch canonical_smiles and substrate_compound_key (cr_substrate.compound_key). Perform a LEFT JOIN on metabolism.metabolite_record_id = compound_records.record_id (alias as cr_metabolite) to fetch metabolite_compound_key (cr_metabolite.compound_key). Map met_conversion and pathway_key from the metabolism table. Apply LIMIT 200.
sql:
SELECT
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  m.substrate_record_id,
  m.metabolite_record_id,
  cr_sub.compound_key AS substrate_compound_key,
  cr_met.compound_key AS metabolite_compound_key,
  m.met_conversion,
  m.pathway_key
FROM metabolism m
INNER JOIN compound_records cr_sub ON m.substrate_record_id = cr_sub.record_id
INNER JOIN compound_structures cs ON cr_sub.molregno = cs.molregno
LEFT JOIN compound_records cr_met ON m.metabolite_record_id = cr_met.record_id
LIMIT 200
